fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Normalized event timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format
fields.justification: Enables chronological sorting and time-range queries across all sources in 3x02 detections and 3x03 triage

source_mapping.windows_json: timestamp_raw field converted to ISO 8601 UTC; already in Zulu format, pass through
source_mapping.linux_text: auth.log/syslog: 'Mon DD HH:MM:SS' parsed with year inferred as 2026 and converted to UTC; audit.log: epoch from msg=audit(EPOCH:COUNTER) converted to UTC
source_mapping.network_csv: epoch seconds in column 1 converted via datetime.fromtimestamp() to UTC
source_mapping.network_json: suricata: timestamp field '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z' converted to UTC; pcap: start_time field '%m/%d/%Y %I:%M:%S %p' converted to UTC

source_mapping.windows_json: hostname field from the NDJSON record
source_mapping.linux_text: auth.log/syslog: token after timestamp in syslog header; audit.log: hostname key from msg='...' payload, fallback to addr field

source_mapping.network_json: null (network sensors and packet captures do not produce hostnames)

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level category: authentication, process, file, network, network_alert, network_flow, audit, powershell, or service
fields.justification: Needed by 3x02 detection rules and 3x03 triage filters to group events independently of source vendor

source_mapping.windows_json: channel=Security event_id 4624/4625/4634/4648->authentication; 4720/4726->authentication; channel=Sysmon event_id 1->process, 3->network, 11->file; channel=PowerShell event_id 4104->powershell
source_mapping.linux_text: audit.log type=USER_AUTH/USER_LOGIN/USER_ACCT/CRED_ACQ->authentication; type=SYSCALL->process; type=SERVICE_START/SERVICE_STOP->service; type=PATH/AVC->audit; auth.log program=sshd/su/login->authentication; program=sudo->process; syslog program=kernel/UFW->network; other->audit

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Severity level: info, low, medium, high, or critical
fields.justification: Enables prioritization of alerts in 3x03 triage and threshold-based detection in 3x02

source_mapping.windows_json: event_id 4625(failed logon)->medium; 4720(user created)->high; 7045(service install)->high; 4698(task created)->high; 4624(successful logon)->info; 4634(logoff)->info; sysmon event_id 1(process create)->info unless image in suspicious path->medium
